evidence_scope: T001 mutation-test review ledger and prior independent findings
authorship_note: This artifact is durable process evidence recording the stated review session and outcome; it does not claim or prove cryptographic authorship.
reviewed_dispositions_digest_definition: SHA-256 of ledger reviews encoded as canonical JSON with sorted keys and compact separators, followed by one LF byte
candidate_review_identity_digest_definit: SHA-256 of the ordered candidate identity strings encoded as canonical JSON with sorted keys and compact separators, followed by one LF byte

prior_independent_findings.finding: The cancellation assertion depended on a scheduler yield and did not prove that the second command had queued on the command lock.
prior_independent_findings.resolved_evidence: The injected _ObservedLock exposes waiter_queued, and the test waits for that event before cancellation while retaining the one-send and unchanged-message-id assertions.

prior_independent_findings.finding: Response-body redaction evidence reused generic body content and did not uniquely demonstrate absence of the supplied response body from every log record.
prior_independent_findings.resolved_evidence: The public stream test supplies a unique response-body sentinel and checks every supplied token, cookie name, cookie value, URL, and body sentinel against every captured log message.

prior_independent_findings.finding: The isolated HTTP error diagnostic did not independently identify both response-body keys and values when proving complete body redaction.
prior_independent_findings.resolved_evidence: The response body now contains distinct key and value sentinels, and both are asserted absent from every captured log message while metadata and a redaction marker remain observable.

prior_independent_findings.finding: The multiple-code-block assertion froze generated layout rather than directly proving semantic content order.
prior_independent_findings.resolved_evidence: The test compares positions of prose and code content in semantic order and separately verifies the two language/code renderer calls without asserting full rendered layout.
